title: Paper Chair · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper Chair · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Give the lead two sheets for folding and a small ball made from a third sheet. The lead folds the sheets into a small freestanding seat without tape. The paper ball rests on the seat for five seconds without falling. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Three sheets of paper; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper Chair, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The paper ball rests on the seat for five seconds without falling.
recall.why: The paper ball rests on the seat for five seconds without falling.

game.materials: Three sheets of paper; a timer
